messages:
sre-bot: INCIDENT P0: sudden spike in garbled model outputs after today's hot rollout. Autoscaler alerts + customer error reports. Paging oncall. :rotating_light:

alice: saw it. dashboard shows encoding errors ~ +14% tokenization failures across us-east cluster.

ben: repro logs attached. samples show mismatched vocab ids -> words replaced by �. stacktrace points at runtime tokenizer init: `vocab_manifest_version=2026-03-17T09:02:11`, weights bundle reports `weights_version=2026-03-17T09:01:55`. looks like async artifact promotion.

mlops: confirming — release pipeline promoted weights artifact `weights:v2.14` but tokenizer package `tokenizer:v2.13` was still on canary. rollout script applied weightset to all regions before tokenizer sync.

carmen: customer-impact check: Support is seeing ~18 unique customers with degraded output, 3 flagged as severe (search/generation critical). Jamie from support on this thread.

support_jamie: verified. One customer (acme-payments) reported failed reconciliation jobs; another (docs.ai) got gibberish in top results. They've paused traffic on their side but want ETA.

alice: immediate mitigation: flip feature flag to stop new rollouts and divert traffic to previous pinned model. eng_release can we hit kill-switch? :thumbsup:

eng_release: flipping `release.hotroll.kill` now. will set traffic weights back to `stable:v2.13` and start rollback plan.

devex-bot: [deploy-bot] rollback job queued: `rollback --target stable:v2.13 --reason "tokenizer-weight mismatch"` (job id rb-1789999998-01). Estimated 3-5m to complete traffic cutover.

ben: quick sanity check: can we hot-patch tokenizer on the nodes instead of full rollback? risk of cache mismatch w/ existing KV caches.

mlops: hot-patch possible for canaries only. For global cutover safer to revert weights. We saw KV cache keys include tokenizer hash so mixing versions will break.

alice: agree -> proceed with rollback. eng_release start rollback, mlops monitor KV cache evictions and latencies. ben, please gather a sample set of failing requests for postmortem.

eng_release: rollback started. changing routing policy: route 100% -> stable:v2.13 for us-east/us-west; leave eu partioned for canary hold.

sre-bot: ALERT: error rate dropping but latency spikes on rolling nodes as model init warms. watch autoscaler.

mlops: KV cache clear in progress. expect short token spikes while caches refill.

carmen: I'll draft a customer note: initial message: brief incident + we are rolling back to stable, ETA 15m for full resolution, follow-up postmortem forthcoming. support_jamie will send targeted messages to the 3 severe customers.

support_jamie: sending now. ACME reply: "Thanks, please notify when resolved — we held traffic."

ben: collecting logs and sample diffs. saved sample batch to s3://redwood-incident/1789999998/samples.json

```
sample snippet:
{"input":"Generate invoice summary","stable_output":"Invoice total: $123.45","broken_output":"Invoice � � �"}
```

alice: rollback completed for us-east/us-west at +7m. Error rates trending down to baseline. EU still on hold.

mlops: EU canary was not promoted; holding until tokenizers sync verified. No additional customer impact reported there.

eng_release: finalizing cut. will keep `release.hotroll.kill` true and block new promotions until postmortem.

devex-bot: [ops] create incident ticket INC-1789999998, owner: alice, severity: P0, linked runbooks: tokenizer-rollout.md, release-checklist.md

alice: immediate action items: 1) full postmortem with timeline + root cause (mlops + eng_release) 2) add pre-promotion check to pipeline ensuring tokenizer+weights artifacts have matching manifest hashes 3) run a smoke test across all regions before 100% traffic 4) customer follow-ups (carmen/support_jamie).

ben: noted. will include sample diffs and a small repro harness.

carmen: drafting customer follow-up now. will include rollback confirmation and timeline.

sre-bot: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. shifting paging to oncall-runbook for 2h watch.

alice: thanks everyone. keeping thread open for postmortem updates. :white_check_mark:
